series: Wave 1 Shorts // Avoiding Money Traps & Calm Budgeting
title: The €400 Holiday Trap (And the 3-Column Rule That Saves €520)

scenes.narration: Seventy-eight percent of people who set a four hundred euro holiday budget end up spending nine hundred and twenty euros by January fifteenth. That five hundred and twenty euro leak happens because you pick the item first and justify the price second.

visual.subtitle: Never Pick the Item First and Justify the Price Second

scenes.narration: Fix it in sixty seconds with the Three-Column Calm Budgeting Rule. Column one: slice off a fifteen percent friction vault for wrapping and shipping first. Column two: lock a strict euro cap next to every name. Column three: always buy at the top of a twenty euro category, never the bottom of a sixty euro category.

visual.title: THE 3-COLUMN CALM BUDGETING RULE
visual.rootQuestion: HARD CEILING: €400 → LOCK €60 FRICTION VAULT BEFORE BUYING ITEM #1
